node.statement: The local bounds epsilon_U,epsilon_R <= W.L*epsilon are explicit additional antecedents of this corrected node, not conclusions of the ledger inequality. Since epsilon>=0 and W.K2>=max{1,W.L,W.c0_cb*W.L}, t_2=W.K2*epsilon satisfies epsilon<=t_2 and W.L*epsilon<=t_2. Combining these with the reset hypotheses d_U<=W.c0_cb*epsilon_U and ||v_U(I)-u_{A_U}||<=W.c0_cb*epsilon_U gives epsilon_U,epsilon_R,d_U, and the reset unit error all at most t_2, using W.c0_cb*epsilon_U<=W.c0_cb*W.L*epsilon<=t_2.
